bucket.description: Public AI gatekeeper intake for dealer financing with real estate collateral.

ai_context.deal_type: dealer financing with real estate collateral

chat_facts.text: cant we do things without the bank statements?

ai_context.collateral_type: real estate collateral and business assets

recent_dealer_chat.author: Bucket AI
recent_dealer_chat.content: Not for a real credit decision. Bank statements are non-negotiable—they're the only way to verify actual cash flow, monthly revenues, and your ability to service new debt. Tax returns show what you earned; bank statements show what actually landed in your account and how you spent it. Without them, I can't screen you past 'maybe,' and no lender will fund on guesses. The good news: this is a fast upload. Three months of EMG's main operating account, all pages, and we move forward.

recent_dealer_chat.author: Denny Matos
recent_dealer_chat.content: cant we do things without the bank statements?

recent_dealer_chat.author: Bucket AI
recent_dealer_chat.content:
Bank statements first—that's the only thing blocking a preliminary screen right now. I can see you've got $39M–$30M in dealership revenue, solid W-2 income, and a $2.2M property in appraisal. But I can't size up your monthly cash flow, debt service capacity, or floorplan load without seeing 3 months of your main operating account.

Once I have those statements, I'll know whether this file supports a real-estate-backed deal, what your DSCR looks like, and what comes next.

recent_dealer_chat.author: Denny Matos
recent_dealer_chat.content: okay what do we need to do then

ai_context.underwriting_focus: Strictly screen Stage 1 bankability for dealer capital without asking the client to choose a loan product. Infer likely paths such as real-estate-backed full doc, DSCR/collateral support, cash-out working capital, portfolio-backed funding, high-cost debt refinance, or floorplan support from the documents and answers. Stage 1 focuses on business tax returns, YTD P&L, main operating bank statements, requested amount, detailed use of funds, stated monthly debt, and estimated credit. Do not ask for the full Stage 2 package until Stage 1 shows good probability. Treat real estate and related LLC/account structure as targeted follow-up clarifications after cash-flow context supports a path.
ai_context.custom_instructions: This is a public lead-magnet strict Stage 1 underwriter for car dealers. Ask first for last 2 years business tax returns, YTD P&L, last 6 months main operating bank statements, requested amount, a detailed use-of-funds breakdown, stated monthly debt payments, and estimated credit. The user may not know which lending product fits. Return one of these probability statuses: Good probability - book call, Promising but needs one clarification, Not enough evidence yet, or Poor probability based on current file. Set booking_recommended true only for Good probability - book call. Return a preliminary screen, not a commitment to lend.
